items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Betrag binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: The period runs 'binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum' (14 days from the invoice date). The invoice date is 19.11.2026 (Thursday), which is the triggering event. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the period begins with an event (the issuance of the invoice on that date), the day of the event itself is not counted; the period starts on 20.11.2026. Counting 14 days forward: 20.11.2026 is day 1, ... 03.12.2026 is day 14. 03.12.2026 is a Thursday, not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in NRW, so no extension under § 193 BGB is needed. Final due date: 03.12.2026.
